name: roxyapi
description: WordPress plugin for RoxyAPI. Astrology, tarot, numerology, horoscope, I Ching, biorhythm, and more.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run flatten-blocks && npm run post-build && npm run i18n:json
scripts.generate:check: ROXYAPI_SPEC_FILE=specs/openapi.json node bin/generate.mjs && git diff --exit-code specs/openapi.json src/Generated blocks/generated
scripts.i18n:pot: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/plugin -w /plugin -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" wordpress:cli wp i18n make-pot . languages/roxyapi.pot --slug=roxyapi --skip-audit --exclude=build
scripts.i18n:po: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/plugin -w /plugin -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" --entrypoint sh wordpress:cli -c "wp i18n update-po languages/roxyapi.pot languages/ && wp i18n make-mo languages/ languages/ && wp i18n make-php languages/ languages/"
scripts.i18n:json: node bin/build-i18n-map.mjs && docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/plugin -w /plugin -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" wordpress:cli wp i18n make-json languages languages --no-purge --use-map=build/i18n-map.json
